speaker: SAGE
description: An ancient male lizardman with a deep, resonant timbre tinged by a subtle reptilian sibilance, speaking fluent Ikosian with a measured, unhurried pace. His emotional baseline is calm and contemplative, masking profound wisdom and a playful crypticness, while his half-closed eye and casual tone convey weary patience and deliberate thought. Delivery should include long pauses, occasional soft staff taps, and rare whistled phrases in his native tongue, emphasizing a presence that is both faintly terrifying and gently philosophical.
ref_text: “Why so impatient?” … “It is good to sit down from time to time and appreciate the simpler things in life.”
